title: Example Game Town Picker — Pre-Run Relic Selection
description: Example Game town picker: unlock it from the permanent-upgrade tree, choose relics for the next run, and how the capacity stat raises the cap.
meta: Town pre-run relic picker. Capacity figures are community-reported; confirm the current cap in-game.

home_also.title: Town Picker
home_also.em: Choose relics before the next run

body:
The Example Game Town Picker is a pre-run relic selector. It is the object in town, separate from the in-run fountain whose effect changes with the water color.

The same object is also searched as the wish well and the relic fountain. Those names point at the town picker on this page.

What it does

Once unlocked, you select relics in town and carry those picks into the next run. Treat it as the step after you have chosen a weapon family.

How you unlock it

Open it from New Events on the permanent upgrades tree, the same early spends that unlock the wardrobe and extra weapons. See the getting started page.

Capacity

  • A community writeup reports a default capacity of 4. Confirm the current value in-game.
  • The capacity stat adds slots at stated talent levels. Write the reported breakpoints here and tell the reader to match them to their own talent screen.
  • Higher rarity is reported to cost more capacity. Confirm the bars in the client.
Keep the in-run fountain on its own page. That object can grant a resource or spawn a fight; it is a different interactable.
